title: +PREPARING FOR CAREERS IN NUTRITION
description: Provides career readiness skills and experiences to nutrition majors.  Explores the educational and experiential paths in respective nutrition major options.  Focuses on the development of the National Association of College Employers (NACE) Career Competencies including career and self-development, communication, critical thinking, equity and inclusion, leadership, professionalism, teamwork, and technology.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CORE 100, 300, BA 100, 300, ED 100, 300, LA 100, 300, SCI 100, 300, ENGR 110, 110H, 310 or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ED 100, ED 300, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100, SCI 300, ENGR 110 and ENGR 110H.
A minimum grade of D is required in ENGR 310.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Nutri Foodserv, Cul & Food Sys (091), Dietetics (419), Nutrition (466) or Nutrition and Health Sciences (467).
